Description
This is a metabolism model of Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288c in SBML format.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort. This file has been exported from the software COBRApy and further processed with the JSBML-based ModelPolisher application.
This file has been produced by the Systems Biology Research Group using BiGG Models knowledge-base version of Nov 21, 2016, where it is currently hosted and identified by: iND750.
